items.body:
### ESLint version

v9.x

### What problem do you want to solve?

`eslint` v9.x versions are not deprecated on npm, only older versions are. Now that v9.x has reached end-of-life, we may consider deprecating v9.x versions as well.

### What do you think is the correct solution?

Deprecate ESLint v9.x packages on npm. This is a follow-up on #18972.

### Participation

- [x] I am willing to work on this change.

### AI acknowledgment

- [x] I did not use AI to generate this issue report.
- [ ] (If the above is not checked) I have reviewed the AI-generated content before submitting.

### Additional comments

No pull request is needed for this change. The packages can be deprecated by logging in to npm as user eslintbot and running:

```shell
npm deprecate "eslint@<10" "This version is no longer supported. Please see https://eslint.org/version-support for other options."
```

See #18972 for more context.
